en: Movement, stamina, damage taken and body zones of the Helldiver type (hd2.helldiver()). Values outside the reviewed range are refused.
zh: 绝地潜兵类型（hd2.helldiver()）的移动、体力、所受伤害和身体部位。超出已审核范围的值会被拒绝。
comment: Intro of the Player page. Keep the code element.

en: Player fields need a newer SDK
zh: 玩家字段需要更新的 SDK
comment: Panel title when the bound SDK has no Helldiver catalog.

en: SDK {0} does not publish HelldiverFieldCapabilities.json. It comes with HD2Runtime 0.30.0.
zh: SDK {0} 未发布 HelldiverFieldCapabilities.json。它随 HD2Runtime 0.30.0 提供。
comment: {0}: the bound SDK version.

en: These values belong to the Helldiver type, so every Helldiver this machine simulates reads them. In practice that is your own Helldiver: other players keep their own movement and stamina. How the zone values affect other players is not known.
zh: 这些值属于绝地潜兵类型，因此本机模拟的每个绝地潜兵都会读取它们。实际上就是你自己的绝地潜兵：其他玩家保留各自的移动和体力。部位数值对其他玩家的影响尚不清楚。
comment: Warning (allow_shared) on the Player page.

en: None of these values has been tried in game. Runtime pins the code that reads each one, but the in-game effect is not confirmed.
zh: 这些值都尚未在游戏中试过。Runtime 已锁定读取每个值的代码，但游戏内效果尚未确认。
comment: Warning (allow_unverified_effect) on the Player page.

en: Changes show only in a mission. The Helldiver aboard the ship keeps a private copy of these values, so it does not change.
zh: 更改只在任务中可见。飞船上的绝地潜兵保留这些值的私有副本，因此不会改变。
comment: Fact on the Player page: the ship avatar's private copy hides type writes.

en: Zone health applies from the next spawn. A Helldiver already alive keeps its current zone health.
zh: 部位生命值从下次重生起生效。已存活的绝地潜兵保留当前的部位生命值。
comment: Fact on the Player page: zone.health is copied at spawn.

en: The game caps the target speed at {0} m/s, so the speed range ends there.
zh: 游戏将目标速度上限设为 {0} 米/秒，因此速度范围到此为止。
comment: {0}: the published speed cap (10).
Player page section: movement speeds.

en: Speeds in metres per second, up to {0}. Aiming, walking, crouched aiming, crouched walking and prone speeds are scaled by the direction factor when you move away from where you face.
zh: 速度单位为米/秒，最高 {0}。朝背离面向的方向移动时，瞄准、行走、蹲姿瞄准、蹲姿行走和匍匐速度会乘以方向系数。
comment: {0}: the speed cap in m/s.
Player page section: stamina.

en: Stamina is a fraction of the bar, from 0 to 1. The game also multiplies costs and drains by its own per-Helldiver cost multiplier.
zh: 体力是体力条的比例，从 0 到 1。游戏还会将消耗和流失乘以每个绝地潜兵自己的消耗倍率。
